Sheriff’s Office
Sheriff Derrick Reifenrath
Serving one of the most beautiful areas in South Dakota and the nation, the Custer County Sheriff’s Office is dedicated to pursuing safe communities, preserving the peace, along with preventing crime and disorder. The men and women of the Sheriff’s Office strive to maintain the highest professional standards while delivering quality service to the citizens we serve. As you visit us here and meet some of them, I am confident you will see what an excellent team we have to address your needs. As Sheriff, my number one goal is to operate within and defend the constitution.
We will strive for excellence in our commitment to provide a safe and secure environment and promote trusting relationships with those whom we serve. I welcome your input, whether it is a suggestion, a complaint or a congratulatory note. Working together, we can form a partnership to make Custer County a safer community.
